senses.gloss: वृषन् ( वृषा ), a term used in ancient grammar works for a word of the masculine gender as contrasted with येषा.
वृषादि a class of words headed by the word वृष which have their initial vowel accented acute; cf. Kas, on P. VI.1.203.
वृष्यण् tad.affix अण् prescribed by the sutra ऋष्यन्धकवृष्णिकुरुभ्यश्च after words denoting members of the Vrsni race; cf. वृष्ण्यणेाSवकाशः वासुदेवः। बलदेव: ॥
